name: Funeral Expenses Payment
description: One-off payment toward funeral costs if you are on a qualifying benefit. Must claim within 6 months of the funeral.
eligibility_summary: Helps pay for funeral costs if you or your partner receive a qualifying benefit such as Universal Credit, Pension Credit, Income Support, or Housing Benefit. Paid back from the deceased's estate if there are sufficient funds. Must claim within 6 months of the funeral.
